rules: One active article at a time; research, implement, independently review, then release its local scope.
Reuse saved evidence and existing profiles before creating content.
Keep poetic language, factual limits, compact numbered footnotes and unique story-relevant images.
Complete means local research/revision/review evidence is saved; publication is tracked separately.
After three genuinely different unsuccessful source approaches, defer the unresolved field with evidence and continue an independent item. Never infer nonpayment from unavailable terms.
No unsolicited contact, purchases, private testimony, deployment or claims of human approval.
